current.text: Jones is in the projected Clippers starting five with Darius Garland, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson. The expert is not confident about this lineup.
The Clippers have many injuries. Ingram, Beal, Jordan Miller and Konan Niederhauser are all out.
Jones should start early, but he will lose value when the injured Clippers return.
A rank in the 200s is right for him. He is worth a look only in 16-team leagues. The experts do not want to invest in him.
The Clippers' rotation is unsettled. The expert expects a trial season with long rotations and many players tested.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28). They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.
The Clippers could be one of the worst teams in the league.

durable.text: Jones has a long record as a poor fantasy contributor. His main help is a steal and a block.
Coach Ty Lue makes odd rotation choices and then changes them.
